_about: Faction story arc, beats 1 and 2, from godot/story/outlines.md (issue 1990). Beat 3 is STORY_BEAT3 in campaign_tables.json; the run ending is RUN_ENDING. Shapes: godot/story/arc.gd.
charge: R-5 Rook's pulsing somewhere inside the Hollow Sun wreck field. Track it down, crack whoever's guarding it, and keep it.
prior_loss: Gossip in the dock bars says the last pack that chased Rook is still welded into the ice near the rim.

A.title: The Torn Den
text: Word across the Ashfall dens says the core R-5 Rook has started pinging from the wreck belt around the Hollow Sun, throwing a steady thermal tick where no live reactor should sit. Your lead howler swears whoever bolts Rook into their flagship won't ever lose a fight again, the same boast heard over every third bottle. Either way, half the belt's spinning up drives, so you jump first or pick through someone else's scraps.

Before you clear orbit, word hits that {rival} raided your forward fuel depot. {rival_deed} Half your captains want to send back a booby-trapped trophy crate; the rest want a loud pre-hunt brawl and feast first.

options.s: The dock bookies start taking bets on your pack: +40 credits. {rival} takes it personally: clock moves on 1.
options.out: The charge goes out bolted inside a stolen hull plate, and the odds Rattlehold posts on your survival are flat-out insulting.
Two loud days of brawling where your howler brags about his eighth challenger, slips up mentioning an old Rattlehold broker, and passes out on a cargo crate.

A.title: The Rattlehold Auction
text: The full wake-log mapping Rook's drift sits inside Rattlehold, the meanest rock-den in sector II, and the den-boss holding it will hand it over to whoever pays top scrap or breaks his champion. Every pack with two guns and a grudge packed the docks. {rival} didn't bother coming inside; {his} fleet hangs cold off the outer rocks waiting to jump whoever walks out with the chart.
Your breach gangs want to smash the docking bays and run dark under the chaos. Your quartermaster says pay the scrap price clean and avoid starting a three-way war.

text.t: Your howler already knows the broker keeping the log and looks distinctly uncomfortable about it.
Word of the rigged crate kept {rival}'s escorts holding extra distance.

options.l: Smash the docks and snatch the log
options.s: Grab the chart plus loose hardware on the clamps: gain salvage. Your next fight starts as an ambush.
options.out: Rattlehold's outer bays burn for four days, and three rival packs put bounties on your hull before the smoke clears.

options.s: Paying fair at Rattlehold turns heads: a Hullbreaker raider crew signs onto your pack.
options.out: Your quartermaster dumps counted scrap straight onto the counter, and an impressed raider captain asks to fly on your flank.

options.l: Send your howler in to lean on the broker (30 credits)
options.s: You get the log plus a Nemesis weakness; your flagship captain loses 15 XP to a brutal hangover.
options.out: Your howler and the broker ran the same belt twenty years back, and whatever they drank settling old business leaves your flag captain useless till morning.

options.l: Remind the hall what happened to your last rival (20 credits)
options.s: Nobody bids against you and you get the log, though word reaches {rival}: clock moves on 1.
options.out: You drop one scorched rivet on the table, and every rival captain suddenly remembers an urgent hull repair.
